laws.rule: Ha Long Bay sightseeing fee per person: Routes 1, 2 and 5 ₫250,000 (about A$13.77 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026); Routes 3 and 4 ₫200,000. Overnight on Route 2: ₫550,000 for one night, ₫750,000 for two.
